problems: The title reads 'Halun — The Full Beak', and the blind guess (tall upright bird, heron or stork, wing extended right) fits the figure: head and beak at top, body down the centre, wing out to the right, tail at lower left.
Beak is weak: star 96683 sits at about (161,113) with a single gold line to the eye (213,175). Nothing reads as a beak, so the 'tip pointing up and out' is only a line.

Right foot (95498, about (249,400)) sits almost on the rump (96275, about (189,403)). The two are 60 px apart, but their labels collide ('the rump, where the tail begins' runs over 'the right foot, tucked under').
Tail tip (97365, about (104,436)) label runs into the rump/foot area ('forked low on the left' overlaps the tail outline).
Wingtip label (92818, about (447,315)) is clipped at the right edge of the frame.
Underside-of-wing label (94703, about (308,357)) is crossed by its own gold line to the wingtip.
Silhouette is a real blue outline, not a copy of the gold lines, and it is upright. The outline does follow the body, but the wing is a thin wedge and the head is not clearly shaped.
output.advice: Keep the layout; it reads as a bird and is the right way up. Fixes are for legibility, not the figure. (1) Move the rump label (96275) and right foot label (95498) to opposite sides, e.g. rump label left-below, foot label right-below, so they no longer overlap. (2) Move the wingtip label (92818) left of the star or above it so it stays inside the frame. (3) Place the underside-of-wing label (94703) below the star, away from the gold line to 92818. (4) Give the beak a slightly thicker, pointed silhouette at 96683 so it reads as a beak, not a stick. Keep the eye (95947) at the crown and the breast (95771) at the chest, as they are.
